page.overview:
Who is Path of the Planeswalker?

Path of the Planeswalker is a compilation of the Planeswalkers webomics, that had appeared on magicthegathering.com, along with the first part of the previously unseen comic Awakenings. It was published on January 5, 2010.

! Title !! Author !! Publishing date !! Set !! Setting (plane) !! Featuring

Three of the eight short stories are standalone, while the other five are interconnected.
